description: Crude Oil Pipelines in Colorado 2014 is a dataset listed in State of Colorado open data portal (data.colorado.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Colorado. Major crude oil pipelines data for Colorado are maintained by the US Energy Information Administration (USEIA) and updated annually. Navigate to source for most current information. Coverage: Colorado. The portal files it under the category Energy. Its tags are bic, crude oil, fossil fuels, oil transportation, united states energy information administration. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: CEO. The portal shows 2015-02-19 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-colorado-gov-portal.
